principle_violations.reason: The Order class is responsible not only for managing the order items but also for maintaining the order status. This mixes item management and order status management, which should be separated.
principle_violations.suggestion: Consider creating a separate class, such as OrderStatus, to manage the status of the order, which would contain methods for setting and getting the status.

principle_violations.reason: The Order class is tightly coupled to a specific way of managing orders. Any modifications for new order types or statuses will require changes in the Order class itself, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create an interface for the Order management and implement various order types or statuses that extend this interface, allowing new functionalities to be added without modifying existing code.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
